data.desc: BigBear.ai is a specialized defense and security technology company providing mission-ready AI. Focused on National Security and Trade & Travel, we build and deploy AI-powered technology, solutions, and services to deliver enduring strategic advantage for the United States, its allies and partners, and critical industries. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, BigBear.ai is a public company traded on the NYSE under the symbol BBAI. For more information, visit bigbear.ai.
